summary: Jupiter Neurosciences filed an 8-K on August 21, 2026, reporting a registered direct offering of 307,692 common shares at $6.50 per share for approximately $2.0 million gross proceeds, with D. Boral Capital as placement agent at a 7.0% fee. The offering was made under an existing effective Form S-3 and is expected to close on August 24, 2026, subject to customary conditions. The filing includes a 30-day restriction on further issuances. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation.
